column1: # DUELL's words for the screen reader (fm1-reader): the text on the screen <TAB> what to say. tools/gen_words.py makes
# web/words/<id>.json (keep every one: a unit in the wild points at its own) and build/gen/ann_words.h (the link).
# Only the short forms still on the screen: most labels are full words already (params.c LBL_SHOWN, mod.c's destination names).
# "#" takes a number and says it; matching is by whole words, capitals ignored, the longest match first. The reader's own common
# words (FX, ENV, LFO, OCT+, dB, Hz, MIDI, RES ...) are in tools/gen_words.py and need no line here.
# the button, not the effects it stands for ("Hold FX": the reader says FX as "effects" otherwise)
